# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source and DESIGN.md §2i, not captured from a run
# Format and semantics: see tests/fixtures/doctor/node_layout/input/systemctl.txt.
#
# CASE: node_layout__system_unit -> Layout::SystemUnit. ARCH'S OWN monerod.service IS RUNNING.
# §2i's system_unit row has two disjuncts:
#   (a) `systemctl is-active monerod.service` (NO --user) is `active`      <- this line drives it
#   (b) /etc/monerod.conf exists AND `systemctl is-enabled monerod.service` succeeds
# Disjunct (b) cannot be fixtured on this machine: no agent can create /etc/monerod.conf and sudo
# needs a password (DESIGN.md §1.1). So this case exercises (a), and (b) is a RED row.
# THE FMONERO UNITS DO NOT EXIST HERE (<exists> is `no`), so the user_unit row cannot also match and
# the order of the two tests does not decide the answer. A case where BOTH are present is a real
# machine state -- the user enables Arch's unit after running `fmonero setup --units` -- and §2i
# resolves it by listing user_unit first; that case is not fixtured, and a Phase 2 doctor agent
# adding it should add a case dir rather than editing this one.
# MainPID 8421 is Arch's monerod, running as user `monero` (upstream's template,
# utils/systemd/monerod.service:1-20). It is the pid node_data_dir_single_writer would report.
fmonero-monerod.service inactive disabled no -
fmonero-wallet-rpc.service inactive disabled no -
monerod.service active enabled yes 8421
